description: Creates custom WordPress Abilities for the WP MCP Adapter (WP 6.9+). An Ability is a PHP class extending Roots\AcornAi\Abilities\Ability that exposes a JSON schema and execute() method — auto-discovered by the MCP Adapter and callable via Claude's execute-ability tool. Covers: lando wp acorn make:ability, AbilitiesServiceProvider registration, JSON schema definition, discover-abilities validation.
